    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"  {n['color']} at rows[{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}], cols[{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}], pixels={n['pixels']}")

    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])

    top_nodes2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['boundary'][0][0] == 0]
    print("Top row after reset:")
    for n in top_nodes2:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
